notes: BMS acquired RayzeBio for ~$4.1B ($62.50/share) — the standout radiopharmaceutical M&A of the 2023-24 cycle and BMS's entry into targeted alpha therapy. Lead asset RYZ101 is an actinium-225 alpha-emitter targeting SSTR2, in Phase 3 for SSTR2+ gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NET) post-Lutathera, with SCLC expansion. Peak-sales estimate $1.5B is sell-side consensus across GEP-NET + early indications; EV/peak ~2.7x reflects the strategic premium for an Ac-225 supply-chain + clinical-stage alpha platform, not just the single asset.
selection_rationale: Canonical actinium-225 alpha-emitter M&A — directly analogous to early-stage Ac-225 programs (Aktis, Convergent, Mariana). Anchors the Oncology · radiopharmaceutical cohort with the highest-profile alpha deal.
source: BMS press release Dec 26 2023; RayzeBio SEC filings; sell-side peak-sales consensus pre-deal (estimate, not company guidance).
